title: Subscriptions & Real-Time
description: Implement real-time features with Apollo Client subscriptions using WebSockets and graphql-ws.
longDescription: This module covers real-time data with Apollo Client subscriptions. You will learn to set up WebSocket connections, use graphql-ws library, handle subscription lifecycle, manage real-time updates in the cache, and build features like live notifications and real-time dashboards.
whatYouLearn: Set up WebSocket connections for GraphQL subscriptions
Use graphql-ws library with Apollo Client
Build real-time features like notifications and live dashboards
